messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Velvet Capital sent an RFI tonight. Core asks: EU-only processing for the POC, a SOC2 Type II excerpt, demonstration of 500 embeddings/sec sustained during market hours, an ops acceptance matrix, and a short pilot SOW. They also asked if we can offer a short-term reserved price that can convert into a 12-month commitment with a conversion discount.

devin_se: Clarify: is the 500/sec an aggregate across endpoints or per model instance? Also ask whether p95 latency constraints exist. That changes recommended topology.

maria_sales: They want aggregate sustained 500/s and noted they'd like p95 <300ms if possible. Their operations team prefers Private or Dedicated for data residency but will entertain Hosted if we can demonstrably isolate EU compute and logs.

devin_se: Quick summary of capability: Hosted (EU control plane) typically sustains ~320-360 embeddings/s with p95 ~260ms on rwd-embed-v1; Dedicated (4xA100 equiv) can sustain 700+/s with 4-bit quant + KV reuse. For POC we should propose Dedicated instances or Private VPC to guarantee residency and deletion certificates.

sara_security: On compliance: we'll provide a redacted SOC2 Type II bundle and current ISO attachments under NDA. Hosted cannot promise HSM-level key custody; we can offer customer-managed keys scoped to our EU control plane. Private deployments support BYOK with HSM.

liam_sre: Draft POC acceptance gates: - Sustained 500 embeddings/sec for a 30-minute window - p95 latency <300ms during that window - KV cache hit-rate >60% for prefix-heavy flows - Cold-start median <50s - Canary rollback test (10% traffic rollback within 5 minutes) - Audit log forwarding to their SIEM. Any additions?
maria_sales: Add 'model pinning and validated rollback' as a gate and a documented deletion/certification step post-POC. Also include SLA expectations during pilot.

devin_se: I'll prepare a technical appendix with repeatable benchmark steps and a small curl harness they can run. We'll include both Hosted baseline numbers and Dedicated lab measurements. Snippet for RFI: ```for i in $(seq 1 600); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v1","input":"sample payload"}' & done; wait```

sara_security: Legal note: deletion certificate requires tenant identifier and a signed request. For Dedicated/Private we can provide a cryptographic signed deletion statement after secure wipe. For Hosted we'll provide purge logs and an audit trail but cannot guarantee physical wipe of shared hardware. I'll draft language.

maria_sales: Pricing ask: can we propose a pilot pricing band? I'd like something conservative.

devin_se: Provisional numbers: Hosted 2-week pilot: $6.5k setup + metered embeddings. Dedicated 2-week reserved burst: $27k (includes reserved discount). If they convert to 12-month reserved pool we can offer up to 18% off depending on commit size. Mark provisional pending final infra sizing.

liam_sre: I'll update the capability matrix to add a 'POC gates' column, 'EU residency flag', and 'deletion certificate' row.

file-bot: Uploaded 'capability_matrix_velvet_v1.csv' (19KB) to thread.

sara_security: I'll attach redacted SOC2 bundle under NDA and a short FAQ about key management options. ETA EOD.

maria_sales: Great. Next actions: Devin - technical appendix + measured numbers by EOD. Sara - redacted compliance bundle + deletion template by EOD. Liam - updated CSV and explicit POC gates. I'll compile and send the RFI reply tomorrow morning and pin the thread. :thumbsup:

devin_se: On it.

sara_security: Copy.

file-bot: Thread pinned in #sales by maria_sales for 72h.
